europe_now.title: German government issues warning after drone incident
europe_now.summary: Chancellor Merz declared that those behind a recent drone incident in Germany 'will pay the price'. The incident adds to heightened European security concerns over unauthorized drone activity near critical sites.

europe_now.title: Sweden moves to seize Russian-owned estate near naval base
europe_now.summary: Sweden's military is seeking to take control of a Russian-owned estate located near a key Swedish naval base, citing national security concerns. The action reflects growing Nordic wariness of Russian assets on sensitive territory.

top_stories.title: Poland's far-right MEP charged with Holocaust denial
top_stories.summary: Polish prosecutors have formally charged a far-right member of the European Parliament with Holocaust denial over remarks calling the Auschwitz gas chambers 'fake'. The case highlights ongoing legal and political battles over Holocaust memory in Poland and the EU.

top_stories.title: Brussels funds Spain's Ceuta response as migration tensions rise
top_stories.summary: The European Commission approved additional funding to help Spain manage a surge of migrant arrivals in Ceuta, an autonomous city on the North African coast. The move came as Madrid clashed internally over whether warnings of the influx were ignored and as Spain's government issued an apology to Ceuta residents.

top_stories.title: Grain exports disrupted by Ukrainian strikes on Black Sea ports
top_stories.summary: Grain exports from the Black Sea region have stalled following an escalation in Ukrainian attacks on Russian port infrastructure. The disruption has implications for global food supply chains that depend on shipments through the region.
